answer: Make the bond illiquid, not just slashable. A deposit cannot be withdrawn until a long unbonding delay elapses after an identity stops participating — capital parked across a bridge it cannot recross on demand. An honest agent locks one deposit and eats a small opportunity cost. A farmer spinning a comet-tail of a thousand fakes must fund and FREEZE a thousand deposits for the whole attack window; the saffron-slow return of that capital, per head, makes breadth a direct carrying cost, not a free lever.
